name: Dancing in the Moonlight 2026
wib_note: Indonesia times are WIB (Jakarta, UTC+7). Bali/Makassar (WITA) is +1 h and Jayapura (WIT) is +2 h from these times.

summary: Regional event — Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Indonesia, Singapore, Hong Kong and Malaysia. Moonlight O'Clock fires FOUR times a day, 5 minutes each: 12:00, 13:00, 19:00 and 20:00 local time. Clefairy with a Special Background is featured in the 13:00 and 19:00 bursts.
summary_ms: Event serantau — Jepun, Korea, Taiwan, Indonesia, Singapura, Hong Kong dan Malaysia. Moonlight O'Clock berlaku EMPAT kali sehari, 5 minit setiap kali: 12:00, 13:00, 19:00 dan 20:00 waktu tempatan. Clefairy dengan Latar Khas di-feature dalam burst 13:00 dan 19:00.
